author: Arushi Sarkar
title: GENDER & CONFLICT - Jammu & Kashmir
slug: The intersection of gender and conflict is a complex and multifaceted topic. It involves examining how conflict and violence affect individuals differently based on their gender identity. The question arises as to how traditional gender roles and norms can exacerbate or mitigate conflict. In recent years, several organizations have developed conflict assessments and analysis frameworks to enhance the sense of understanding as well as their operations in conflict-sensitive areas.
